title: Шеф без документов  (The Chef Without Documents)

segments.t: Determined not to push his luck twice, Max prepares a genuinely meatless batch of rolls for Nastya's guest and keeps the meat-filled ones for himself. Outside on the street, police officers stop Chef Barinov wandering in pajamas without any identification.
А спасибо.
Держи вегетарианские рулетики.
Но если увидишь Сеню и Федю.
Их ты чего, это меня надо бояться.
Такие аппетитные рулетики, сама бы их съела.
Да чего я не боюсь.
Тем более вегетарианец.
Очень смешно.
Можно ваши документы?
Граждане полицейские, у меня нет с собой документов.
Да вы что?
Я шеф-повар ресторана Клод Мане.
Виктор Баринов.
Now let's go back through the conversation line by line.
А спасибо.
'Oh, thank you.' By telling Nastya to thank Nastya, Barinov keeps his side of the story grounded.
Держи вегетарианские рулетики.
'Here are the vegetarian rolls.' Admitting that here are the vegetarian rolls shows Vika being honest for a change.
Но если увидишь Сеню и Федю.
'Just make sure Senya and Fedya do not see you.' Saying that just make sure Senya and Fedya do not see Barinov is how Nastya sets the tone with Barinov.
Их ты чего, это меня надо бояться.

'Why be afraid of them, I am the one they should fear.' Once why be afraid of them he is the one they should fear, Barinov can finally tell Nastya what he means. Russian packs the whole idea of what is allowed or needed into one impersonal word at the front.
Такие аппетитные рулетики, сама бы их съела.
'Such appetizing rolls, I would eat them myself.' Adding that such appetizing rolls she would eat them herself fills in the missing piece for Barinov.
Да чего я не боюсь.
'What would I not be afraid of.' Nastya tells Barinov that what would she not be afraid without dressing it up.
Тем более вегетарианец.
'Especially since I am a vegetarian.' Since especially since he is a vegetarian, Barinov does not waste words on excuses.
Очень смешно.
'Very funny.' With the police and moment in play, Vika keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Можно ваши документы?
'May I see your documents, please?' Nastya asks whether may she sees Barinov's documents please, refusing to let the point slide.
Граждане полицейские, у меня нет с собой документов.

'Officers, I do not have my documents on me.' Because officers he does not have his documents on him, Barinov treats the matter as settled. Russian expresses having something as "by me is", keeping the phrase short and grounded.
Да вы что?
'Oh, really?' Around the kitchen and police, Vika wants to know where Barinov really stands. Notice how she sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them.
Я шеф-повар ресторана Клод Мане.
'I am the head chef of the Claude Monet restaurant.' Noting that she is the head of the Claude Monet restaurant keeps Nastya's side of the story simple and clear.
Виктор Баринов.
'Viktor Barinov.' With the hospital and kitchen in play, Barinov keeps this short reply brisk and direct. Alright, let's hear the whole conversation once more from start to finish.
А спасибо.
Держи вегетарианские рулетики.
Но если увидишь Сеню и Федю.
Их ты чего, это меня надо бояться.
Такие аппетитные рулетики, сама бы их съела.
Да чего я не боюсь.
Тем более вегетарианец.
Очень смешно.
Можно ваши документы?
Граждане полицейские, у меня нет с собой документов.
Да вы что?
Я шеф-повар ресторана Клод Мане.
Виктор Баринов.

That wraps up this scene as max hands Nastya a purely vegetarian batch of rolls while keeping the meat ones for himself, and police officers stop Chef Barinov on the street in his hospital robe. Until next time!
До завтра!
